project_info.name: SmartProv
project_info.description: Stripe-meets-Linear-meets-Telefônica. High-density, function-first, crisp, and authoritative.

brand.name: SmartProv
brand.logo_concept: Heavy, crisp sans-serif wordmark. 'Smart' in Midnight Indigo (#0F172A), 'Prov' in Azure Blue (#0055FF). Sharp, precise geometric cuts in the letters.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-semibold
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-semibold

dashboard.density: compact layouts, minimal whitespace between related data points to maximize screen real estate

icons.style: Duotone for marketing, Regular/Bold for dense dashboard UI

buttons.primary: bg-brand-primary text-white hover:bg-brand-primary_hover transition-colors font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 shadow-sm
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-lg overflow-hidden
cards.metric: p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col gap-1 border-l-4 border-l-transparent hover:border-l-brand-primary transition-all

tables.header: bg-slate-50/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-y border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider sticky top-0 z-10

forms.input: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-primary/20 focus:border-brand-primary transition-all shadow-sm
forms.label: block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5

hero.copy_direction: Clear, quantified outcomes. Example: 'A infraestrutura do seu provedor, orquestrada com IA.'
hero.layout: Split layout or centered text over an immersive subtle background (using server room image). Use glassmorphism for floating UI elements showing platform preview.
hero.cta_hierarchy: Primary CTA: 'Agendar Demonstração' (Azure Blue). Secondary CTA: 'Conheça a Plataforma' (Ghost).

social_proof.layout: Horizontal marquee of telecom/ISP client logos in grayscale.
social_proof.copy: Confiado por mais de 500 provedores regionais.

features_bento.layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid (TETRIS mode). 1 large hero cell (SmartOLT), 2 medium (Lousa, WhatsApp), 1 tall (Map).
features_bento.style: Cards with 1px border, subtle inner glow. High contrast text.

pricing.layout: Pricing cards with 'Tracing Beam' border effect on the recommended tier.

cta_section.layout: Full width, deep Midnight Indigo background, Stark White text, Azure Blue button.

sidebar.style: Left-aligned, collapsible. Background: Midnight Indigo (#0F172A) for strong separation, or stark white with a solid right border.
sidebar.items: Phosphor icons + Text. Active state gets an Azure Blue left border highlight and light blue background tint.

topbar.style: Sticky, glassmorphism or stark white with thin bottom border. Contains global search (Cmd+K), notifications, user profile.
topbar.actions: Quick-add button (e.g., '+ Novo Assinante') prominently displayed.

states.empty: Subtle gray dashed border container, central Phosphor icon (Duotone, text-slate-300), clear heading, and a primary CTA to create the first item.
states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the layout geometry. No generic spinners for full pages. Use a subtle shimmer effect.
states.error: Card with left border Signal Red. Clear error message + 'Tentar novamente' button.
states.success: Toast notifications (using Sonner) at top-right or bottom-center. Green icon, dark text.

motion.microinteractions: Buttons scale down slightly on active state (active:scale-[0.98]).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum contrast. Use text-slate-700 or darker for body text.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Use data-testid on all interactive elements.

mobile_responsiveness.breakpoints: Mobile-first approach. Use hidden md:block to hide complex tables on mobile, replacing them with stacked card layouts.
mobile_responsiveness.navigation: Hamburger menu triggers a full-screen or sliding drawer for the sidebar.
mobile_responsiveness.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for buttons and icon buttons on mobile.

kanban.layout: flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 pb-4 h-[calc(100vh-12rem)] snap-x
kanban.column: w-80 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 snap-center
kanban.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md p-3 mb-3 shadow-sm cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:border-brand-primary/50 transition-colors
kanban.tags: Use subtle background colors (e.g., bg-blue-50 text-blue-700) for visual categorization.

map_technicians.style: Muted-light map style to reduce visual noise. High contrast Azure Blue markers for technicians.
map_technicians.overlay: Floating glassmorphism panel (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border border-slate-200) for technician details. Absolute positioning over the map.

smart_olt.typography: Heavy use of JetBrains Mono for IP, MAC addresses, and dBm readings.
smart_olt.indicators: Pulsing status dots (Green for Online, Red for LOS/Alarm). Use dense grid layouts for ONU lists.

whatsapp_omnichannel.layout: Split pane: 1/3 list (left), 2/3 chat window (right). Full height layout (h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]).
whatsapp_omnichannel.chat_list: Dense list. Unread messages have a bold font and a blue dot indicator.
whatsapp_omnichannel.chat_bubble: rounded-2xl px-4 py-2 max-w-[80%]. Outgoing: bg-brand-primary text-white. Incoming: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900.

images.description: Architectural photograph of a modern server room, glowing with subtle cyan lights. Use for Landing Page Hero background with a glassmorphism overlay.
Blue and white light fiber optic cables. Use for SmartOLT or infrastructure features on the landing page Bento Grid.
Telecom field technician on a tower. Use for the Map/Field Tech management feature section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react). Avoid default lucide-react if possible to maintain the specific brand aesthetic.
Do not use generic Shadcn 'Card' wrappers for marketing page layouts. Use raw divs with grid systems to achieve the Bento layouts and overlapping sections.
Implement dense tables with sticky headers, zebra striping, and right-aligned numbers for the 10k+ row data views.
Use JetBrains Mono for any technical data (IPs, MAC addresses, connection stats) in the dashboard.
Never use generic purple gradients. Stick strictly to the crisp, high-contrast, 'Telefônica-Blue' and Stark White theme.
